policy.accepted: Verified existing mapping or unique normalized exact name, same type, preferred English source, without contradictory casting discipline or knack minimum rank
policy.approximate: Suggestions only; uuid remains null. Legacy-schema candidates are suggestions only. Community/older-edition definitions require review even for exact names.
policy.unmatchedEdid: EdIdField.generateEdId formula using the installed Foundry strict slugify; reserved none/any values are not reused. Two generated double-hyphen slugs are retained verbatim and flagged edidNeedsReview.
policy.scope: All installed registered Earthdawn standalone Item packs, plus discovered ed4e Item packs; actor-owned items excluded. Only pack.system=ed4e may supply accepted UUIDs.
policy.knacks: ImprovedSpell -> spellKnack; Karma -> knackKarma; Maneuver -> knackManeuver; otherwise inferred knackAbility. Inferred types remain visible in the review.
policy.language: English UUIDs preferred; ED-ID may be reused cross-language by the importer
